texts: An associated interrupted aortic arch is an independent risk factor for mortality after repair of an AP window: D.
Isolated windows are repaired with low operative mortality, under 5 percent in recent series, and late survival is good, about 90 percent at 10 years.
Outcome depends mainly on the associated lesions, above all the interrupted arch, rather than on the size of the window.
In the picture, only the patched hotel whose orca was also cut in two has a coffin beside it.
Memory hook: the porthole is easy; the cut orca is the danger.
